summary: Verified Phase 2 iteration: Node.js Express backend swap and Supabase-backed admin media library (with credentials intentionally absent). 16/16 backend pytest cases pass. Admin UI sign-in, tab switching, upload-not-configured error surfacing, and sign-out all work. Public-site regression for Rewari intro About link is fixed.
critical_code_review_comments: media.js download handler duplicates admin-token check inline instead of reusing adminOnly middleware — acceptable since the guard supports ?token= for anchor links, but a small dedicated middleware (adminOnlyAllowQuery) would DRY it up.

AdminMedia.jsx embeds the admin token in image and anchor href query strings. This is required because / can't set Authorization headers, but the token WILL appear in server access logs and browser history. Consider signed, short-lived download URLs once Supabase creds are wired in.

requireStorage runs after multer would parse the file for /upload only because it is placed before upload.single('file'). This is correct and prevents wasting bandwidth on multipart parse when storage is not configured — good.
server.js: 404 handler uses app.use('/api', ...) which will also swallow subroute 404s. Currently harmless because subrouters return their own 404s first, but worth noting.
test_credentials: Admin token: mahawar-admin-dev-token (from /app/backend/.env). No Supabase credentials — intentionally absent.
seed_data_creation: None. FileAsset collection remains empty; upload path returns 503 before touching Mongo.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend now runs Node.js Express (GET /api/ -> runtime:'node'). Tests cover: root, locations list/detail/404, /api/admin/media/status (public), list with/without auth (Bearer and x-admin-token), invalid scope, upload without token, upload with token when storage not configured (503 STORAGE_NOT_CONFIGURED — this fires BEFORE type validation because requireStorage runs before multer parses file, so the 415 UNSUPPORTED_TYPE branch is unreachable while Supabase creds are blank; this is documented and expected), delete without/with token, and _id/__v hygiene. Once SUPABASE_URL + SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY are added, add tests for real upload success, download stream, delete-with-storage, and 415/413 branches. Admin UI reachable at /admin.

observed_behaviour_notes.upload_wrong_type_when_storage_not_confi: POST /api/admin/media/upload with category=gallery + text/plain returns 503 STORAGE_NOT_CONFIGURED (not 415 UNSUPPORTED_TYPE) because requireStorage middleware precedes multer parsing. This matches the reviewer expectation stated in the request.
